paragraphs.source_en: Tears once more streamed down his face as he kept his eyes fixed on Oharu. Oharu's eyes remained narrowed as she gazed silently at Hachiya. paragraphs.source_en: Oharu had not been mad... Unable to condemn Hirotada for his heartlessness, she had resolved to give her life for Hachiya, whom Hirotada had cast aside. Oharu had revealed Hirotada's secret. She wanted Hachiya to tell Hirotada that, for the sake of their interests, Oharu had to be killed—then Hirotada's doubts and suspicions would be dispelled, and Hachiya could return to his side once more.
